title: Lambda memory over-provisioned 23.5x
description: aicoe-lab-function runs a constant-time handler using ~36 MB but is configured with 3008 MB, so every billed millisecond costs ~23.5x what it needs to.

detection.secondary: CloudWatch Logs REPORT line: compare 'Max Memory Used' with 'Memory Size'

remediation.verification: MemorySize == 128 and the function still returns the expected response
